source_mapping: Authoritative /spec/source.txt is formalized in Research/Submission.lean: exactProductTree maps each pair to its exact real product; roundedProductTree maps each pair to Model.mul; roundedDotProduct uses roundedSum on those rounded products. The final theorem quantifies over every supplied Model and pair tree, assumes only ((tree.depth + 1 : Nat) : Real) * model.u < 1, and asserts a shape-preserving leafwise perturbation of exactProductTree bounded by gamma (tree.depth + 1) model.u whose exactSum equals roundedDotProduct. All five supplied supporting modules were copied unchanged. Statement revision: none; /spec/feedback.json was absent. The theorem proof is temporary sorry scaffolding for the next proof role; all construction bodies are defined.
